content.headline:
From the ashes of
Steel City rust to the future of
Artificial Intelligence
content.subheadline: Youngstown, Cleveland, and Pittsburgh produced the steel that built this country. It provided a life and a future for generations of families — but that era had an expiration date. What didn't expire was the people. Some of the sharpest, most resilient minds in America live along the corridor connecting our three cities. Youngstown may stay divided over sports, but our roots run deeper than any rivalry.

content.headline: What is RustLoop?
content.subheadline: RustLoop has a simple mission: bring together the best minds working on Artificial Intelligence — and open the doors so the public can listen in. Our country, and the world, is welcoming a transformation we haven't seen since the advent of electricity. This region helped power the last industrial revolution. We intend to help power the next one.

items.question: Who is RustLoop for?
items.answer: Anyone interested in AI and machine learning — data scientists, ML engineers, researchers, students, hobbyists, and the simply curious. Whether you're training models at work or tinkering on weekends, you belong here.

items.question: Where do meetups happen?
items.answer: We rotate between Youngstown, Cleveland, and Pittsburgh. Locations are announced on the events page and through our mailing list.

items.question: How do I get involved?
items.answer: Sign up for an account, attend a meetup, or just start reading the blog. There's no application process — show up and be part of it.

items.question: Is there a cost?
items.answer: RustLoop is free to join. We're a community organization, not a business. Some events may have nominal venue costs, but we work to keep everything accessible.
